title: Penthouse Magazine April 1983 Complete w/ Centerfold Jimmy Carter Interview
conditionDescription: Vintage 1983 issue. Covers clean and bright. Small chips at the top and bottom corners of the front cover along the spine, and a few small white marks near the spine edge. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, April 1983 issue, original $3.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover features: Jimmy Carter's frankest interview - what he couldn't say as President; the Deadly Yakuza: Mafia made in Japan; David Brenner's autobiography; fiction by Anthony Burgess; Michael Korda on power drinks.

Back cover: Carlton cigarettes ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
